title: Power Automate: configure Flow checker rules and notifications for desktop flows in the admin portal
summary: Hold: the automation shown for configuring Flow checker rules only retrieves records and cannot make the advertised changes. The roadmap facts and documented portal settings are supported, but the licensing field also understates the published Managed Environments entitlement.
